title: House rules.
field_audio_hint: Sub matches Japanese audio with subtitles. Dub uses dubbed audio.
field_quality_hint: "Best" lets the source pick. Lower values cap the resolution.
field_external_player_hint_prefix: Command launched by "Open in external player". Defaults to
field_external_player_kind_hint: Players take their options in different ways. Pick the closest match, or Custom to write your own argv template. Watch together uses this choice too, for the player Syncplay opens.
field_external_player_custom_args_hint_s: . A token whose placeholder is missing (e.g. no subtitle) is dropped, so optional flags don't end up empty. Example:
field_syncplay_binary_hint_prefix: Path to the Syncplay program that Watch together uses. Syncplay is a separate download, available at
field_auto_play_next_hint: When the current episode ends, advance to the next one automatically. Stops at the last episode of the series.
field_cache_resolutions_hint: Reuses a stream link found in the last 7 days instead of looking it up again. It's faster, but you may keep getting a release-day encode for up to a week. That's why it's off by default.
field_download_bar_hint: A thin accent-coloured strip along the bottom while downloads run. When off, downloads still work, and their progress shows only on the download icon in the topbar.
field_auto_skip_op_hint: Jump past the OP automatically when one is detected. It's off by default. While it's off, the Skip button lets you skip by hand. Timestamps come from the aniskip community.
field_auto_skip_ed_hint: Jump past the ED automatically when one is detected. Pairs well with Auto-play next for binge sessions.
field_custom_controls_hint: Replace Chromium's built-in controls with the app's own. The timeline takes each show's accent colour, and the Skip button stays visible in fullscreen. When off, Chromium's controls are used. They work better with picture-in-picture and the built-in captions menu.
field_update_include_prereleases_hint: When on, the update badge also offers pre-releases, such as betas and release candidates. Every ani-gui release so far is a pre-release, so turning this off hides all updates until the first stable one.
field_language_hint: The language of the app's text. Anime titles aren't affected.
field_image_cache_cap_hint: Posters and banners saved to disk. The ones viewed least recently are removed when the cap is reached.
field_clear_images_hint_prefix: Removes posters and thumbnails on disk at
field_clear_images_hint_suffix: . Useful after Kitsu updates its images, or to free disk space before the cap is reached.
about_disclaimer_text: ani-gui scrapes public sources. Use only where local laws permit. The maintainers don't operate, host, or guarantee any of the upstream content.
error_file_invalid: The settings file (config.toml) isn't valid. If you edited it by hand, check it for mistakes.
error_file_unreadable: The settings file couldn't be read or saved. Check that the file and ani-gui's config folder are readable and writable.
